body:
Yes — Hermes supports arbitrary stdio MCP servers, same shape as Claude Code's `mcpServers`. Top-level `mcp_servers` key in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:

```yaml
mcp_servers:
  mempalace:
    command: python
    args: [-m, mempalace.server]
    env:
      MEMPALACE_DB: /path/to/kg.db
```

Or interactively: `hermes mcp add mempalace --command python --args -m mempalace.server`.

Lifecycle: the gateway spawns your stdio MCP subprocess at startup, keeps one long-lived ClientSession per server, auto-reconnects with backoff if the subprocess dies, and cleans up on shutdown. macOS caveat worth knowing: gateway-under-launchd can have env-inheritance quirks (#14113) that don't show up running `hermes chat` directly — worth testing both paths before cutting over production agents.

Docs: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/reference/cli-commands#mcp  Go/no-go should be green for MemPalace. Closing as answered — reopen if you hit a specific integration snag.
